title: Crone Archetypes
name: Crone
summary: Ending and elderhood; the task is to release, reveal, and transmit hard-won wisdom.
essence: Truth beyond approval, reverence for cycles, and service free of the need to be central.

items.name: Crone
items.gifts: The underworld-queen current: ending, composting, grief, and the threshold of renewal.
items.growthPath: Release what is finished while carrying forward its truth and nourishment.
practices: Name what must end and what deserves to be remembered.
Create a small ritual that marks an irreversible transition.

shadows.name: Scorched-Earth Crone
description: Release abandons remembrance and becomes indiscriminate severing. She burns relationships, roles, or histories at the first scent of decay, mistaking destruction for transformation. Nothing can teach or compost when it is denied all value.
declarations: If it is flawed, it must be ended completely.
Looking back only weakens resolve.
I owe the past nothing.
balancing: Separate what must end from what can be retained.
Grieve before making irreversible cuts.
Carry one lesson or blessing across the threshold.
shadows.gift: Her fearlessness becomes clean closure when it makes space without erasing meaning.
outOfBalance: Uses total severance as first response

shadows.name: Relic Keeper
description: Release fails as remembrance hardens into preservation. She maintains dead roles, loyalties, and identities because letting them end feels like betrayal. The past is honored so completely that it cannot become nourishment for the present.
declarations: Letting go would mean it did not matter.
I must keep this exactly as it was.
Moving on is disloyal.
balancing: Distinguish memory from continued obligation.
Choose a finite form for honoring what ended.
Make one present-tense commitment after grieving.
shadows.gift: Her fidelity becomes ancestral wisdom when memory can travel without the corpse of the old form.

mature.title: Mature Crone
paragraphs: The Mature Crone knows what must die, what must be mourned, and what can be carried onward in changed form. She neither sterilizes grief nor builds a home inside it. By remembering truly and releasing fully, she returns the past to the soil of future life.

declarations: I release the form and keep the wisdom.
Grief honors what mattered and makes movement possible.
An ending can be exact without being cruel.
I let the past become soil, not residence.

balance.qualities: Truthful, Fearless, Catalytic, Sovereign, Compassionate, Deep, Transformative, Clear, Mystic, Liberating

virtues.title: Release
paragraphs: Release ends attachment to forms whose life or season is complete.

virtues.title: Remembrance
paragraphs: Remembrance preserves meaning, lineage, and learning across the threshold of loss.

items.name: Elder Healer
items.gifts: The elder priestess: compassionate wisdom that serves without owning the cure.
items.growthPath: Stay tender enough to care and detached enough to honor mystery, limits, and death.
practices: Offer what is yours to give, then release the outcome.
Notice whether hope is serving the person or your identity as healer.

shadows.name: Martyred Healer
description: Compassion refuses detachment and makes every suffering a personal summons. She overidentifies with pain, continues beyond usefulness, and cannot accept limits, refusal, or death without experiencing them as failures of love.
declarations: I must stay until this is healed.
Stepping back would abandon them.
A good healer never stops caring.
balancing: Clarify what is and is not yours to carry.
Let another person decline or outgrow your help.
Grieve limits instead of trying to conquer them.
shadows.gift: Her devotion becomes profound accompaniment when she can remain loving without controlling the ending.
outOfBalance: Sacrifices health to preserve a healer identity

shadows.name: Cynical Healer
description: Compassion recedes into detachment hardened by disappointment. She sees patterns and limits accurately but uses that knowledge to avoid being moved. Experience becomes superiority, and realistic prognosis becomes a defense against encounter.
declarations: People rarely choose real healing.
I already know how this story ends.
Distance is the price of wisdom.
balancing: Meet the person before the pattern.
Offer one sincere act without demanding change.
Let grief soften what experience has armored.
shadows.gift: Her realism becomes seasoned equanimity when it protects care from fantasy rather than from feeling.

mature.title: Mature Elder Healer
paragraphs: The Mature Elder Healer can love what she cannot fix. She brings experience, proportion, ritual, and presence, then releases ownership of the outcome. Her detachment is spacious rather than cold: it lets illness, choice, mystery, and mortality remain larger than her role.

declarations: I offer care without claiming the cure.
Compassion can remain when intervention ends.
Limits are part of honest healing.
I meet this person, not only the pattern I recognize.

balance.qualities: Compassionate, Boundaried, Wise, Restorative, Devotional, Grounded, Humble, Ethical, Steady, Nourishing

virtues.title: Compassion
paragraphs: Compassion stays emotionally available to suffering and responds with humane care.

virtues.title: Detachment
paragraphs: Detachment releases control of outcome, preserving perspective, mystery, and the other's path.

items.name: Elder Visionary
items.gifts: The elder oracle and moon-seer: long vision seasoned by cycles and consequence.
items.growthPath: Offer far-seeing truth at the moment and scale where it can become useful.
practices: Translate one large pattern into a timely next step.
Ask whether an insight is yours to speak, now, to this person.

shadows.name: Premature Oracle
description: Vision disregards timing. She delivers distant truths before trust, readiness, or context can hold them, then mistakes incomprehension for others' lack of depth. Even accurate insight becomes intrusive when it steals another person's unfolding.
declarations: They need to hear the whole truth now.
Readiness is only resistance.
My vision exempts me from ordinary context.
balancing: Ask permission before interpreting another's path.
Offer the next useful piece, not the whole map.
Let silence preserve someone else's discovery.
shadows.gift: Her far sight becomes wise guidance when revelation respects sequence and consent.

shadows.name: Withholding Seer
description: Vision retreats into endless waiting. She recognizes a consequential pattern but postpones speaking until the moment has passed, calling fear discretion. Timing becomes a refuge from the exposure and responsibility of being clear.
declarations: It is not quite the right moment.
They will see it when they are ready.
I should not interfere.
balancing: Name the smallest truth that is timely now.
Set a threshold beyond which silence becomes neglect.
Speak plainly and release control of reception.
shadows.gift: Her patience becomes mature discernment when it does not abandon the moment that needs her voice.
outOfBalance: Speaks only after outcomes are obvious

mature.title: Mature Elder Visionary
paragraphs: The Mature Elder Visionary sees long patterns and honors human sequence. She does not use mystery to elevate herself or prediction to control the future. Her counsel arrives in plain language, at a usable scale, and leaves the listener freer to choose.

declarations: I offer the portion of vision this moment can use.
Silence and speech both answer to service.
I see patterns without claiming the whole design.
My counsel returns authority to the listener.

balance.qualities: Attuned, Seasoned, Far-seeing, Cyclic, Gentle, Exact, Listening, Guiding, Patient, Kind

virtues.title: Vision
paragraphs: Vision perceives long arcs, hidden relationships, and consequences beyond the immediate frame.

virtues.title: Timing
paragraphs: Timing respects readiness, sequence, consent, and the ripeness of action.

items.name: Rebel
items.gifts: The revolutionary trickster: liberating disruption, wit, and refusal of stale authority.
items.growthPath: Break what constrains life and accept responsibility for what the break makes possible.
practices: Name the freedom sought, not only the rule opposed.
Before disruption, identify who bears the cleanup and transition.

shadows.name: Chaotic Rebel
description: Liberation throws off responsibility and becomes reflexive destruction. She opposes structure for the thrill of rupture, externalizes every consequence, and calls harm inevitable collateral. Freedom remains adolescent because it creates nothing durable.
declarations: Any limit is oppression.
Disruption is its own success.
The cause excuses the damage.
balancing: Define the life-giving alternative before dismantling.
Take responsibility for foreseeable impact.
Preserve structures that still serve.
shadows.gift: Her refusal becomes catalytic courage when it clears ground for a viable freedom.

shadows.name: Compliant Critic
description: Liberation collapses beneath responsibility recast as permission-seeking. She sees what is stale, speaks cynically in safe company, and continues complying because no action is guaranteed to be clean. Critique protects her identity while the system remains unchanged.
declarations: Nothing I do will alter the system.
Acting would make me part of the problem.
I am responsible as long as I disapprove.
balancing: Choose one rule you can meaningfully refuse.
Join others already building an alternative.
Accept imperfect action with transparent accountability.
shadows.gift: Her caution becomes strategic dissent when it enters the arena and shares the cost of change.

mature.title: Mature Rebel
paragraphs: The Mature Rebel is loyal to liberation rather than to rebellion itself. She exposes stale norms, disrupts with proportion, and helps build forms that can hold the freedom she seeks. Humor keeps her from sanctimony; responsibility keeps her from making other people pay for her purity.

declarations: I rebel for a freedom I can help sustain.
Disruption is a tool, not an identity.
I answer for the consequences of my refusal.
I can preserve what works while transforming what does not.

balance.qualities: Playful, Subversive, Liberating, Ethical, Quick, Inventive, Insightful, Courageous, Light-hearted, Purposeful

virtues.title: Liberation
paragraphs: Liberation releases life and agency from domination, inherited limits, or dead forms.

virtues.title: Responsibility
paragraphs: Responsibility accepts impact, interdependence, and the work of building after refusal.
